FICTIONAL TEST REPORT
ULTRASOUND OBSTETRIC, DATING AND VIABILITY
Date of examination: 15/02/2025
Clinical details: Pregnant, last menstrual period uncertain, light bleeding.
FINDINGS:
A single intrauterine gestational sac is seen, with a yolk sac and a live embryo. The fetal heart activity is present at a rate of 156 beats per minute. The crown-rump length measures 38 mm, corresponding to a gestational age of 10 weeks and 6 days. The estimated date of delivery by ultrasound is 22/09/2025. A small subchorionic collection measuring 14 x 6 mm is seen at the lower edge of the sac. The cervix is closed. The uterus is anteverted. The right ovary is normal and contains a corpus luteum cyst of 20 mm. The left ovary is normal. There is no free fluid in the pouch of Douglas.
IMPRESSION:
1. Viable singleton intrauterine pregnancy at 10 weeks and 6 days.
2. Small subchorionic haematoma.
